verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, meaning no way to select many findings, PRs or repositories and apply one action to all of them. The nearest items are adjacent: org-wide default config via a `cubic-config` repo, merging a PR stack in order, repository-wide codebase scans, and CSV export. None of these is a documented bulk action across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
